verdict.rationale: Typesense's ranking docs cover ranking by relevance plus popularity and by relevance plus recency, tie-breaking-based ranking, a default ranking order, boosting or burying sets of records, and merchandising (promoting or hiding results), so business signals clearly shape ranking beyond text match. A community user praised the compact sort_by syntax for ordering by numeric fields. One practitioner noted fewer tuning knobs than Lucene, but that is general opinion rather than a concrete failure. Missing for 10: explicit evidence for margin or arbitrary custom-signal weighting, in-depth documentation detail beyond section headings, and hands-on corroboration of popularity or recency ranking in practice.
